The "Lunch" option is currently highlighted in blue, indicating it is selected. Each meal type has a three-dot menu icon next to it, suggesting additional options or settings for each meal type. At the top right corner, there is a plus (+) icon, likely for adding a new meal type. The screen has a simple and clean design with an orange header and a white background.
